shared_elements: highly schematic anthropomorphic form with elongated body and outstretched arm
elongated vertical composition dominated by a tall narrow figure
curved/hooked linear element extending from a body
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by tall, narrow schematic anthropomorphic forms with arms extended and a curved appendage or held object, which is the only substantive correspondence. Otherwise the content differs entirely: A shows a pair of paired human figures alone with no animals or ornament, while B is filled with registered rows of profile animals, birds, a snake, a quadruped and a woven/zigzag band, none of which appear in A.
